title: Sail
statementMd:
The polar bears are going fishing. They plan to sail from $(*s*_{*x*}, *s*_{*y*})$ to $(*e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*})$. However, the boat can only sail by wind. At each second, the wind blows in one of these directions: east, south, west or north. Assume the boat is currently at $(*x*, *y*)$.

- If the wind blows to the east, the boat will move to $(*x* + 1, *y*)$.
- If the wind blows to the south, the boat will move to $(*x*, *y* - 1)$.
- If the wind blows to the west, the boat will move to $(*x* - 1, *y*)$.
- If the wind blows to the north, the boat will move to $(*x*, *y* + 1)$.

Alternatively, they can hold the boat by the anchor. In this case, the boat stays at $(*x*, *y*)$. Given the wind direction for $*t*$ seconds, what is the earliest time they sail to $(*e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*})$?

## Input

The first line contains five integers $*t*, *s*_{*x*}, *s*_{*y*}, *e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*}$ $(1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{5},  - 10^{9} ≤ *s*_{*x*}, *s*_{*y*}, *e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*} ≤ 10^{9})$. The starting location and the ending location will be different.

The second line contains $*t*$ characters, the $*i*$-th character is the wind blowing direction at the $*i*$-th second. It will be one of the four possibilities: "E" (east), "S" (south), "W" (west) and "N" (north).

## Output

If they can reach $(*e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*})$ within $*t*$ seconds, print the earliest time they can achieve it. Otherwise, print "`-1`" (without quotes).

## Note

In the first sample, they can stay at seconds $1$, $3$, and move at seconds $2$, $4$.

In the second sample, they cannot sail to the destination.
statementZhMd:
北极熊们要去捕鱼。他们计划从 $(*s*_{*x*}, *s*_{*y*})$ 航行到 $(*e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*})$。然而，船只能借助风力航行。在每一秒，风会向以下四个方向之一吹来：东、南、西或北。假设船当前位于 $(*x*, *y*)$。

- 如果风向东吹，船将移动到 $(*x* + 1, *y*)$。
- 如果风向南吹，船将移动到 $(*x*, *y* - 1)$。
- 如果风向西吹，船将移动到 $(*x* - 1, *y*)$。
- 如果风向北吹，船将移动到 $(*x*, *y* + 1)$。

此外，他们也可以抛锚让船停下。在这种情况下，船会停留在 $(*x*, *y*)$。给定未来 $*t*$ 秒内的风向，求他们最早在什么时候能够航行到 $(*e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*})$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含五个整数 $*t*, *s*_{*x*}, *s*_{*y*}, *e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*}$ $(1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{5},  - 10^{9} ≤ *s*_{*x*}, *s*_{*y*}, *e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*} ≤ 10^{9})$。起点和终点的位置不同。

第二行包含 $*t*$ 个字符，其中第 $*i*$ 个字符表示第 $*i*$ 秒的风向。它是以下四种字符之一："E"（东）、"S"（南）、"W"（西）和 "N"（北）。

## 输出格式

如果他们能在 $*t*$ 秒内到达 $(*e*_{*x*}, *e*_{*y*})$，输出他们最早到达的时间。否则，输出 "`-1`"（不含引号）。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，他们可以在第 1、3 秒停留，并在第 2、4 秒移动。

在第二个样例中，他们无法航行到目的地。
